brands.evidence: Yes, Monzo is a properly regulated UK bank, and your money is protected if it fails.

client_claims.text: Monzo is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by both the PRA and the Financial Conduct Authority.
Your Monzo money is covered by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS).
The FSCS limit is £120,000 per depositor per bank.
The FCA fined Monzo £21.1m for operational compliance systems, with issues from 2018–2020 since remediated.
Monzo is a full bank with its own licence, not just an app or e-money account.
client_claims.note: Facts say it is a UK bank authorised by the PRA but do not mention its own licence.

client_claims.text: Stocks & Shares ISAs and General Investment Accounts have a separate £85,000 protection.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover investment protection.

client_claims.text: Some Monzo savings pots are held at other banks, such as OakNorth, and count towards your limit at that bank.
Business account eligible deposits are protected up to £120,000 in total.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover business accounts.
